newsitem.title: USA: Dow off highs, program trade curbs lifted.
newsitem.headline: Dow off highs, program trade curbs lifted.

text.p: Wall Street stocks retreated from their session peaks, with the Dow industrials slipping back to trade nearly unchanged in late afternoon.
The Dow stood at 6669, up 10 points for the day after rising as high as 6712. The NYSE lifted its index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1450 EDT/1850 GMT.

"We once again tested what looks like real resistance," said Eugene Peroni, chief technical analyst with Janney, Montgomery Scott. "For now it looks like our short-term trading boundaries are 6400 and 6700 (on the Dow)."
